body_markdown:
Gaurav Khanna


Chief Digital & Information Officer


Gaurav Khanna is chief digital & information officer for Ardent Health, leading the company’s technology, data, artificial intelligence and digital strategy in support of patient care, operational excellence and long-term growth. He brings more than 20 years of healthcare technology leadership experience, with a focus on using digital, data and AI capabilities to advance business transformation, operational performance and consumer experience.


Before joining Ardent, Khanna served as vice president and segment chief information officer for CenterWell Pharmacy, part of Humana’s healthcare services business. He previously served as chief information and digital officer for Contessa Health and held senior technology leadership roles at eviCore Healthcare and Express Scripts. Khanna holds an Executive MBA from Rutgers University and a bachelor’s degree in computer engineering from Lehigh University.
